description: This file defines the template class StaticAddressMap, which provides a read-only mapping from addresses to entries, wrapping a StaticMap. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and references to external headers.

classes.name: StaticAddressMap
classes.description: A wrapper class for StaticMap providing read-only address-to-entry mapping, with methods for retrieving entries based on address.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Locates the entry stored at the highest address less than or equal to the given address; returns false if no such range exists.
